title: Spatially Varying Label Smoothing: Capturing Uncertainty from Expert Annotations
mechanism: Convolve one-hot labels with a Gaussian so boundary pixels get soft targets and interiors stay hard, encoding annotation position uncertainty.
adaptation: For a 1.75 px crack every pixel is boundary, so SVLS becomes a soft crack band covering the 1-2 px jitter. Sigma per source from label width (ARTS 1.5 px to SDLE 3.25 px) as a second arm. Train with JML or DML instead of house soft Dice; re-pick the crack logit bias on val because soft targets shift the argmax width.
min_experiment: Arm SVLS (sigma 0.7 px) + JML vs SUP100, 5 v 5 seeds. Metric clean-49 crack IoU at val-chosen bias, relF1@2, relP@2. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 or relP@2 drop > 0.05.
evidence: R: better boundary prediction and calibration on 4 clinical segmentation tasks, single and multi-rater (abstract).
prior_overlap: Related but not the same: offset-tolerant CE (P14, 10% labels, min over shifts) was n.d.; soft Gaussian targets with an IoU loss at 100% labels never run.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply SVLS (sigma 0.7 to 1.0) only to the crack channel in CE, giving a soft 3 to 4 px band matching the 4 px FWHM line; keep Dice on the hard crack label; structural classes unchanged.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + SVLS on crack CE. Baseline: house. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if both < house + 0.005. About 6 GPU-h.
